title: Great Pyramid as a device for balancing Earth's energy

tellings.quote: I actually believe that part of the function of the Great Pyramid of Giza and other structures um was a balancing the energy

related.note: Both tellings credit Christopher Dunn with an energy function for the Great Pyramid, but this one says it balanced the Earth's energy where the story says it was a power plant generating energy.

plain: The Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt, along with other ancient structures, may have been built partly to balance the Earth's energy, not only as a tomb or monument. The researcher Matt LaCroix offers this as his own belief on Michels's show, drawing on the work of a writer on the pyramid named Christopher Dunn. If true, it would mean the ancient builders understood a kind of energy that we have since forgotten.
